verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection SaaS platform, so asking about scheduled or recurring automation is a fair question. The evidence only shows event-driven API calls (Checkout, Sale) and decision webhooks. Polling the Get Decision API would be a user-side workaround, not a product scheduler, and nothing documents recurring jobs or scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
